metrics.note: Subsurface flow verified; discharge comparison not meaningful at dx=5000m (KI lesson dt_pf_v006)

subsurface_flow_verified.explanation: Top layer saturation correctly increased from 0.666 to 1.000 over 31 days in response to 167.6mm CMFD rainfall. Bottom layer saturation slowly increased (0.666->0.720) showing downward percolation. Ponding began when top layer fully saturated (day 30). K=1.04 mm/hr > mean rain rate=0.225 mm/hr, so all rain infiltrated (no Hortonian excess), consistent with loam soil. Saturation-excess runoff began day 30 when soil column filled.

issues: Shapefile area (15,964 km2) does not match expected basin area (30,630 km2)
At dx=5000m, overland flow routing is too slow for meaningful discharge (confirmed KI lesson dt_pf_v006)
All rain infiltrated (K=1.04 mm/hr > mean rain rate), so simulated discharge=0
No CLM/ET => all rain goes to storage or runoff; overpredicts subsurface wetting
Basin-average forcing loses spatial variability; no tool for distributed forcing at ParFlow resolution
ki_gaps: build_subsurface_properties falls back to default loam for ALL cells; does not actually query HWSD MDB for per-cell sand/silt/clay

generate_parflow_script.py still contains known bugs (dt_pf_v001: OverlandKinematic=1 causes KeyError; dt_pf_v002: missing PhaseSources/KnownSolution keys) - users must reference validated run scripts instead
convert_forcing_to_pfb.py generates dummy/default forcing values; does not actually read CMFD/MSWX data - manual forcing extraction required
No automated tool to bridge basin-scale domain (dx>=1km) with hillslope-scale overland flow (dx<=100m) for discharge estimation
define_parflow_domain.py elevation stats include DEM nodata values (32767) without filtering
No tool for multi-year continuous simulation (cycle repeat logic is 31-day only)
No calibration workflow or parameter sensitivity tool specific to ParFlow (unlike VIC vic_cali_ai)
Missing link between KI subsurface output and observed discharge for validation; the parflow_to_cama coupling tool exists but is untested
